inventoryNote: The ticket contains 15 occurrences of 13 unique immutable keys. Occurrence 1, the Ice Golem Complete line-142 key, was already reviewed and held by #270 (scripts/catalog/legal/inherited-notices-270.json), which landed first; it resolves to that unchanged Registry record and hold, and this batch adds no record, block or hold for it, leaving 12 new unique blocks. Occurrences 5 and 6 repeat the Iron Cobra Complete line-147 key; occurrences 12 and 13 repeat the Kamadan Complete line-154 key. Each duplicate resolves to its single canonical Registry record. Unlisted lines 143, 148 and 155 are trailing-space variants: they are not added, corrected or aliased, and their original text remains in the upstream permanent notice block.

comparisons.result: Three distinct complete Ice Golem physical notices: Complete © 2011; Revised.© 2002; unqualified Tome of Horrors, © 2002. Each names Scott Greene. Revised.© has no separating space. Exact wording and punctuation are retained without corrections or inferred version equivalence.

The Complete 2011 and unqualified 2002 Iron Cobra physical notices both name Scott Greene and original material by Philip Masters. Different dates and editions remain distinct; no version equivalence or alias is inferred. The Complete wording also occurs in the unreviewed owner Bestiary 6 seed, which does not establish a printed check or a complete book chain.

The complete line literally says Copyright 2003 Paizo Publishing, Author: Lizard -- Used With Permission. This inherited wording is preserved verbatim; it does not establish fresh permission, content attribution, Paizo product identity or the full notice chain.

The complete Jade Regent Player’s Guide notice literally uses Paizo Publishing, LL C. The apparent publisher spacing discrepancy cannot be resolved from the permitted evidence; no inferred LLC repair is applied. A separate wording hold remains enforced.

The complete Jubilex notice literally uses Revised.© 2002 with no separating space and names Scott Greene and Clark Peterson, based on original material by Gary Gygax. It is not the Complete 2011 owner-transcription seed and is not aliased to it.

Into the Darklands literally says Copyright 2008 and names James Jacobs and Greg A. Vaughan. The complete Jackalwere, Kamadan, Kech and Kelpie notices each say © 2011 and name Scott Greene; the original-material credits are Gary Gygax, Nick Louth, Gary Gygax and Lawrence Schick respectively. All wording is retained without editorial or product-code additions.
